notes:
Summary: Regional government authority evaluating Redwood Private for regulated, on-prem inference. Primary driver: run sensitive analytics and ops-assistants in air-gapped facilities with strict change control.

Key constraints / quotes: • "We cannot allow internet egress from the inference cluster under any circumstances" (Security Dir). • Must support HSM-backed keys (FIPS), auditable request logs, and retention knobs. 

Workload profile: mixed chat (internal ops assistants) + high-volume reranking for alert prioritization + periodic large-batch document summarization for legal/extract. Latency requirement: median <= 120ms token latency for interactive assist (local network), throughput: sustained 800 concurrent streams during peak. Cost sensitivity: mid (willing to pay for air-gapped assurances, but looking to optimize GPU utilization).

Technical asks: • Fully air-gapped install media and offline license activation. • Hardened OS image + STIG checklist + integration runbook for SIEM (Splunk) and CMDB. • Support for customer KMS/HSM (bring-your-own HSM), hardware crypto module, and remote attestation for nightly integrity checks. • Rollout: canary across two secured datacenters, automatic fallback to quantized model variant on capacity pressure. 

POC plan and acceptance criteria: • Deploy Private control plane in dedicated management VLAN; 1 rack with 8x A100 or equivalent; provide model-variant with quantization; demonstrate offline model import, prefix caching, and KV cache snapshot/restore. • Perf: p95 token latency < 250ms under 800 concurrent streams; correctness: L1 policy-check recall >= 98% on provided test set. • Security: successful penetration test checklist items 1-10; KMS integration and audit logs available to SOC. 

Decision process: procurement + security board reviewing SOW and legal terms. Next major milestone is budget signoff and site-readiness window (they expect 8-12 week hardware lead time).

Stubs / references: pricing deck (/drive/pricing/crowhurst-proposal-v3.pdf), security FAQ (/drive/security/crowhurst-security-faq.xlsx), legal redlines in gmail thread: thread:1845-legal-clauses.

AE notes (Ava): keep responses terse, escalate STIG gaps to platform security. SE Rohan to produce an offline-install checklist and BOM for procurement. Follow-up: schedule site-readiness call by 2026-03-10; ask customer for preferred HSM vendor and existing CMDB endpoint.
